Substations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This
document outlines the minor maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed 
every three years or every 
1000 
operation as indicated 
by Y3 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Fawzy Hanafy Mahmoud, 
tested at
Solb El Makhsous 220kv substation at 19 May 2003, 
reviewed by eng. El-Sayed Mohamed Ebaid , accepted by eng. Mohamed Abdel Latief:: 
General Director of Sadat & Tahrer Badr Substation and approved at 21 May 
2003, West Delta Zone.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear appropriate personal protective 
 equipment must be used, safety 
 shoes, helmet breathing mask, safety glasses
Circuit breaker must be fully isolated.
Earthing switch must be closed on both sides of the breaker
The circuit breaker should be switched off and ground the CB an both 
 sides.
Switch off control current for CB (d.c)
Tools and Equipment
Tester (digital Avometer).
Set off spanners and screw drivers.
Oscillograph.
Silicon grease, Vacuum cleaner.
Operating oil (MIL - H - 5606)
500/1000 V Megger.
Contact resistance meter.
Work to be Carried Out
Check the tightening of bolts and nuts .
Check rusting or peeling of paints.
Check discoloration or heat hase due to over heating of 
 main terminal.
Check cracking.
Check position indicator and operating counter.
Check auxiliary switches by tester.
Check pole discrepancy.
Check operating time by osillograph,
 - Opening time below 0.03 sec.
 - Closing time below 0.1 sec.
 Note : Operating times are to be within 10% from the data obtained last time .

Record the following oil pressure : 
 - Oil pump operation, starting and stopping 
 - Low pressure alarm
 - Closing interlocking
Record the time between 320 &340 kg/cm2 .
Check the accumulator gas (N2 )pressure 220 bar at 20
 Ċ
Record the time 
 between o bar to 340 bar
Check gas density operation
Gas density monitor setting
Greasing
Coat the joints with silicone grease.
Insulation resistance of control circuit 2MΩ 
 or more , measuring by 500 v megger
Insulation resistance of main circuit 1000 MΩ 
 or more, measuring by 1000 v megger
Moisture content 
 measuring (max. 300 ppm v)
Check gas leakage.
Check contact 
 resistance of main circuit.
Record counter reading of breaker and pump for each pole .
Check no oil leakage
Check the rated gas pressure (6 bar at 20 )
Check oil level in the tank 
 Note : this document must be carried out to each pole of the circuit breaker.
